purpose: Teach: 乗り入れ/交わさ/晒し/臆病/上等/物凄い/隅々/善良

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、新しい鉄道が乗り入れされて村が賑わった
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, a new railway came through our village and everything changed.
lines.style: Soft, distant voice like gazing into a decades-old memory. Gentle pace. Slight pause before specific details—he's seeing it again, not just recalling it. Warm nostalgia, no sadness.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、毎朝挨拶を交わされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, Grandpa—you and the station master used to exchange greetings every morning, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Affectionate, slightly teasing. She knows this story. Tender lift in her voice—playful validation that she was watching him too. Warm, familiar rhythm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが大根を晒して干された
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father would dry daikon radishes in the sun behind the house.
lines.style: Voice settles deeper into memory. Simple, observational. He's not explaining—he's showing her a picture. Steady, almost meditative pace. No hurry.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃は臆病な少年だったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa—you were such a timid little boy back then, weren't you, dear? I remember how you'd hide.
lines.style: Gentle, knowing laugh in her voice. She's correcting him gently, offering him a different memory—one where she saw his softness. Warm teasing, not criticism.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが上等の着物を仕立てて下さった
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father had a fine kimono tailored for me.
lines.style: Quieter now, more fragile. This one means something—a gift, a kindness he's carried seventy years. Breath comes softer. Voice catches just slightly on the word 'fine.'

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、戦地で物凄い経験をされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, you experienced such terrible things in the war, didn't you, dear? And yet you never let it show.
lines.style: Her voice steadies. No lightness now—this is witness. She's naming what he carried silently all those years. Respectful, sad-admiring. Slow. She knows he won't confirm it directly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが家の隅々まで掃除された
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father would clean every corner of the house, every single one.
lines.style: Almost whispered. He's naming cleanliness—discipline, care, order—things that matter to him because they mattered to his father. Voice trails on the word 'corner.' He's losing the thread gently, or choosing not to finish.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、善良な村人として尊敬されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, the whole village respected you as a good man, didn't they, dear? They knew what you were.
lines.style: Close, intimate voice—like she's speaking to him alone, not to the world. Final affirming statement. She's not asking, she's confirming. Soft finality. Love underneath.
